<thought>Based on the exact mass (~178 Da) and the 13C NMR data (one carbonyl at 166 ppm, a methoxy carbon at 52 ppm, two aliphatic CH₂ signals, and six aromatic carbons), the most consistent structure is a methyl ester of phenylpropanoic acid (methyl phenylpropionate). Its SMILES is “COC(=O)CCCc1ccccc1”. This matches the formula C₁₁H₁₄O₂ (DBE = 5) and the observed spectral features.</thought>
<final_answer>COC(=O)CCCc1ccccc1</final_answer>
